record.field: Attach reception picture for quality checks

# ───────────────────────────────────────── # CONFIG # ───────────────────────────────────────── OK_TAG_ID = 5
# ───────────────────────────────────────── # LANG (calculado una sola vez, fuera del loop) # ───────────────────────────────────────── SPANISH_LANGS = {"es_ES", "es_MX", "es_AR", "ca_ES"} lang = env.context.get("lang") or env.user.lang or "en_US"
if lang in SPANISH_LANGS: txt_ok = "✅ Recepción OK" txt_warn = "⚠️ Incidencia detectada" txt_detail = "Detalle" else: txt_ok = "✅ Reception OK" txt_warn = "⚠️ Incident detected" txt_detail = "Detail"
# ───────────────────────────────────────── # PRE-FETCH: adjuntos existentes en batch # (una sola query para todos los pickings) # ───────────────────────────────────────── valid_records = records.filtered( lambda r: r.x_studio_delivery_note and r.x_quality_check_id and r.x_quality_check_id.picking_id )
picking_ids = valid_records.mapped("x_quality_check_id.picking_id.id")
existing_attachments = env["ir.attachment"].search_read( [ ("res_model", "=", "stock.picking"), ("res_id", "in", picking_ids), ("name", "like", "Delivery Note -"), ], fields=["res_id", "name"], )
# Set de (res_id, name) ya existentes — O(1) lookup existing_set = {(a["res_id"], a["name"]) for a in existing_attachments}
# ───────────────────────────────────────── # MAIN LOOP # ───────────────────────────────────────── for record in valid_records: picking = record.x_quality_check_id.picking_id attachment_name = "Delivery Note - %s" % picking.name
# Skip duplicado en O(1) if (picking.id, attachment_name) in existing_set: continue
# ── STATUS ─────────────────────────── tags = record.x_studio_incidence_type # acceso único al campo tag_ids = tags.ids tag_names = tags.mapped("name")
is_ok = bool(tag_ids) and all(tid == OK_TAG_ID for tid in tag_ids) status = txt_ok if is_ok else txt_warn detail = ", ".join(tag_names)
# ── ATTACHMENT ─────────────────────── attachment = env["ir.attachment"].create({ "name": attachment_name, "type": "binary", "datas": record.x_studio_delivery_note, "res_model": "stock.picking", "res_id": picking.id, })
# Añadir al set para evitar duplicados dentro del mismo lote existing_set.add((picking.id, attachment_name))
# ── MESSAGE ────────────────────────── body = status if not detail else "%s — %s: %s" % (status, txt_detail, detail)
picking.message_post( body=body, attachment_ids=[attachment.id], )
